# Astronics Corporation Announces Fiscal Year 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results Conference Call and Webcast


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_3a07f9f9387817a516b3ce89bb855c10/astronics/news/2026-10-28_Astronics_Corporation_Announces_Fiscal_Year_2026_466.pdf) October 28, 2026


EAST AURORA, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Astronics Corporation](http://www.astronics.com/) (Nasdaq: ATRO), a leading provider of advanced technologies for global aerospace, defense and other mission critical industries, announced that it will release its fiscal year 2026 third quarter financial results after the close of financial markets on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.


The Company will host a conference call and webcast that same day to review its financial and operating results and discuss its corporate strategies and outlook. A question-and-answer session will follow.


***Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Conference Call***


Tuesday, November 10, 2026
4:45 p.m. Eastern Time
Phone: (201) 493-6784
Webcast:[investors.astronics.com](https://investors.astronics.com/)


A telephonic replay will be available from 8:00 p.m. ET on the day of the call through Tuesday, November 24, 2026. To listen to the archived call, dial (412) 317-6671 and enter replay pin 13762682. The webcast replay can be accessed via[the investor relations section of the Company’s website](https://investors.astronics.com/news-events) where a transcript will also be posted once available.


**ABOUT ASTRONICS CORPORATION**


Astronics Corporation (Nasdaq: ATRO) serves the world’s aerospace, defense, and other mission critical industries with proven, innovative technology solutions. Astronics works side-by-side with customers, integrating its array of power, connectivity, lighting, structures, interiors, and test technologies to solve complex challenges. For over 50 years, Astronics has delivered creative, customer-focused solutions with exceptional responsiveness. Today, global airframe manufacturers, airlines, militaries, completion centers and Fortune 500 companies rely on the collaborative spirit and innovation of Astronics. The Company’s strategy is to increase its value by developing technologies and capabilities that provide innovative solutions to its targeted markets.


For more information on Astronics and its solutions, visit[Astronics.com](http://www.astronics.com/) .
